title: Review Handoff
description: Structure of .reviews/handoff.json — what one round of cross-model review needs to know before it starts. Hand-crafted by the implementing agent; consumed by the reviewer (codex / cross-model-review skill / human).

supersedes_round.description: Set when this is a re-review of an earlier round; reviewer should compare deltas.

mission.description: What this round of review is for. One paragraph. Be concrete about scope.

success.description: What CERTIFIED looks like — enumerated success criteria the reviewer must verify.

failure.description: What NOT_CERTIFIED looks like — enumerated failure modes the reviewer should hunt for.

files_changed.description: Files modified or created in the round under review. Use absolute repo-relative paths.

files_unchanged.description: Files NOT changed in this round whose prior state must still hold (e.g., earlier round's fixes verified intact).

review_instructions.description: How the reviewer should structure their pass — phases, what's in/out of scope, what the response must include.

preflight_path.description: Repo-relative path to the preflight-vN.M.X.md document (if any).

response_path.description: Repo-relative path to .reviews/response.json (where the reviewer's structured findings land).

artifact_path.description: External link to the artifact under review (commonly the GitHub repo URL or PR URL).

test_counts.description: Per-suite pass count. The total key (if present) should be the sum of per-suite counts.

live_e2e_verified.description: Optional natural-language note about live E2E verification scope (e.g., 'opencode-ai@1.14.33 — plugin auto-load + 4 skills discovered').
